description: Use this when writing Blueprint rows for a Brilliant design: it loads Brilliant's Blueprint and design knowledge pages by key (blueprint/core, blueprint/layout, blueprint/paint, blueprint/text, design/foundations). Each key pulls in its prerequisites unless includeDependencies is false; all loads the whole tree page by page within the response budget.

all.description: Load every page of the tree (the response budget defers the rest by name).

includeDependencies.description: Also load the assumes: prerequisites of each key. Default true.

keys.description: Knowledge keys, each a path under the knowledge tree without .md (blueprint/core).

name: get_knowledge
title: Load Brilliant knowledge
